newsitem.title: USA: ARCHER DANIELS CUTS PILGRIM'S PRIDE STAKE.
newsitem.headline: ARCHER DANIELS CUTS PILGRIM'S PRIDE STAKE.

text.p: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co said Tuesday it has reduced its stake in Pilgrim's Pride Corp to 6.38 percent, or 1,761,382 shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Decatur, Ill, food conglomerate said it sold 3,753,518 shares in Pilgrim's Pride, a Pittsburg, Texas, chicken producer, on July 22 at $11.625 each.
